title: The raven (Genesis 8:6-7) compared with Satan cast out (Ezekiel 28:16)
summary: Genesis 8:6-7 (Noah sends out a raven that flies to and fro until the water dries up) is set beside Ezekiel 28:16 (the covering cherub cast out of the mountain of God). The slide labels the raven as sent out / to and fro / doesn't return, and Satan as cast out / to and fro / doesn't return. A row of six symbols (hammer and sickle, yin-yang, skull and crossbones, peace sign, crescent and star, swastika) sits between the two passages.

text.text: 6 After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark
7 and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.
RAVEN: Sent out / To & Fro / Doesn’t Return
16…and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
SATAN: Cast out / To & Fro / Doesn’t Return

numbers.note: after forty days Noah opened the window and sent out the raven

pictures.description: A row of six small black symbols: hammer and sickle, yin-yang, skull and crossbones, peace sign, crescent moon with star, and a swastika, set between the raven passage and the Ezekiel passage.
